## Package registration

- Package repository:
- What it does / permission use:

- [ ] I own or am authorized to submit this public repository.
- [ ] Root `manifest.json` and referenced resources are present.
- [ ] I added one `registry/<id>.json` file; metadata remains in the package manifest.
- [ ] I tested import and each declared entry in AnyWhere.
- [ ] The repository includes its license and usage instructions.
- [ ] I did not edit generated `catalog.json`.

Maintainer: verify ownership and licensing, inspect source and capabilities, then review CI.
